title: FairLens AI
summary: An enterprise-grade platform for auditing algorithmic bias, simulating policy impacts, and enforcing AI compliance, built as a Google Solution Challenge project. Its 'Smart Data Generator' module fits SDV's CTGAN, TVAE, and Gaussian Copula single-table synthesizers on user datasets to produce synthetic data for fairness testing, with SDV's synthesizers run directly to generate the mitigation datasets.
